F_plan is MEASURED, not UNMEASURED: the forced-hash CUBRID plan matches PostgreSQL's per-node row counts to 0.19%. perf: CUBRID native IPC 0.94 rises to 1.96 at matched shape vs PostgreSQL 1.95, so F_cost is an instruction-count deficit (2,274 vs 991 instructions per tuple touch), not stalling.
